_source: Scuffle design doc pp. 5-8 (Weapons): 44 named there, and four of Depth's own to make the doc's 48 (the Tesla gaff, the flare pistol, the speargun, the dealer's bottle). Damage per hit; rate in shots a second; ammo; knock and recoil in m/s given to the body; speed of the projectile in m/s (0: a beam or melee); spread in degrees; head: the headshot multiplier; area/area_dmg for explosions. 'stage' is the build stage that switches the weapon on. Weights: the crate's odds per arsenal (and per world, from stage 5).
